limits: The independently rerun focused host tests do not establish the currently running aggregate suite results.
No Kotlin compilation, JVM test execution, Android/native build, APK/device run or accessibility-service verification performed; exact-head hosted results remain required.
Caption presence and attachment checks are not full clipping/layout certification.
Pinned acceptance constants are a code-review trust boundary: deliberate edits to validators/constants themselves still require independent review.
No inherited-language, whole-language, native-human, production, merged-source or release certification.
